worker_claim.report: Validation: ./dev test-parallel -q passed with 1845 passed and 2 skipped; ./dev lint and git diff --check passed. The disposable fixtures reproduce the reported causal path without accessing live-service state.
worker_claim.summary: Separated current failure visibility from worker admission authorization using shared, cached first-parent lifecycle proofs. Unrelated workers no longer revive superseded failures; matching ownership and recovery warnings remain visible, while removal and post-transition edits can retire status entries without authorizing re-execution. Added real-Git and CLI regressions covering restart, lifecycle transitions, ambiguous changes, and preservation of historical evidence.
